name: Safai Karmakar Prasuti Sahayata Yojana
briefDescription: Chhattisgarh State Government started a scheme "Safai Karmakar Prasuti Sahayata Yojana" for unorganized worker on 11 March 2015.
descriptionMd: Labor Department of Chhattisgarh State started this scheme &quot;Safai Karmakar Prasuti Sahayata Yojana&quot; for unorganized worker on  11 March 2015. The main objective of the scheme to empower unorganized worker by providing financial assistance for Maternity Assistance.
benefitsMd:
- Female employees will receive a financial assistance of ₹4,200 in the third month of pregnancy and ₹2,800 in the eighth month of pregnancy as maternity benefit.
- Male employees will receive a financial assistance of ₹3,000 as paternity leave after the birth of the child.
eligibilityMd:
1. Applicant(Male or Female) must be registered worker.
1. Benefits will be provided only for two children.
